title: Make Learn-it Next CI product-relevance aware
purpose: Run Learn-it Next product CI only for Learn-it Next or Atlas-relevant changes, preserve exact existing product routes and exact-head dispatch proofs, and avoid false-red product verification on unrelated infrastructure changes.
invariants: Only the Learn-it Next CI workflow and this work-package file may change.
All existing Atlas branch routes remain exact and unchanged for product-relevant changes.
All existing Wave A branch routes remain exact and unchanged for product-relevant changes.
workflow_dispatch modes and exact-head proof semantics remain unchanged.
A product-relevant change on an unrecognized pull-request branch fails closed.
Relevant pushes to main retain existing post-merge product verification.
Infrastructure-only, governance-only and work-package-only changes do not trigger Learn-it Next product verification.
A change to .github/workflows/learnit-next-ci.yml remains executable as an auditable CI-router self-test.
Repository governance, PR scope, main protection, product sources, tests, manifests, run_checks.py and rulesets are not weakened or edited.
requiredEvidence: Changed paths are exactly .github/workflows/learnit-next-ci.yml and work-packages/CI-WP-004.json.
Repository governance is green on the exact head.
PR scope is green on the exact head.
Learn-it Next CI executes the workflow-audit route successfully on this workflow-only product-irrelevant change.
Event path filters include Learn-it Next, authoring v2, contracts and this workflow, while excluding tools/ai_jobs, tests/ai_jobs, governance and work-package-only maintenance.
Known Atlas and Wave A product branch route tables are preserved byte-for-byte except for the unknown-branch fallback behavior.
Unknown branches are allowed to self-audit workflow-only changes but are rejected when any product-relevant path is present.
Main post-merge routing classifies a workflow-only non-product merge as ci-router rather than Wave A.
adversarialTests: Known Atlas pull request plus apps/learnit-next path routes to its existing Atlas profile.
Known Wave A pull request plus apps/learnit-next or authoring/v2 path routes to wave-a.
Unknown pull-request branch plus apps/learnit-next, authoring/v2 or contracts path fails closed.
ops branch with only tools/ai_jobs or tests/ai_jobs paths does not trigger Learn-it Next CI.
ci branch, governance-only change or work-package-only change does not trigger Learn-it Next product verification.
Main merge containing Learn-it Next product paths retains the existing post-merge product classifier.
Main merge without product paths does not fall through to artificial Wave A verification.
Changing .github/workflows/learnit-next-ci.yml triggers ci-router self-test and does not bypass fail-closed product routing.
nonGoals: Changing any Learn-it Next source or product test.
Changing apps/learnit-next/dev/run_checks.py or any source manifest.
Changing Repository governance or PR scope semantics.
Changing branch protection, rulesets or required global status checks.
Adding infrastructure branch-name allowlists to product verification.
Merging or releasing from this lane.
independentReview: Independent exact-head CI review must verify event-path semantics, fail-closed unknown product routing, preserved Atlas and Wave A routes, and the eight-case matrix before merge.
rollback: Close the draft pull request without merge, or revert only the Learn-it Next CI workflow relevance router and CI-WP-004 metadata after merge.
